The closest relevant content pertains to different types of paper, a design tool called Paper, a Minecraft server software called Paper, and a sketch and create app also named Paper, but none of these are related to a framework paper. The FDA's discussion paper on the regulation of generative AI-enabled medical devices also does not mention a "ManuRAG framework paper."
